integrity: All finite extrema obtained by exhaustive exact integer recurrence and independently checked by five-position enumeration; no extrapolation to infinite length.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for five-letter nonalternating four-run binary patterns and host lengths five through eight only. Does not assert general all-length extremal structure. Unindexed finite tables remain a novelty risk.
title: The first four-run subsequence-packing split in binary words
